name: mt_bench_vietnamese
description:
MT-Bench Vietnamese
	


  


This repo contains the Vietnamese translation for the popular MT-Bench dataset.
This dataset was translated first by GPT-4o, and then corrected by a Vietnamese speaker, Chau Nguyen, who is both a Vietnamese native and a PhD student at JAIST.
This is part of three language datasets that we have added to the MT-Bench benchmark:

Indonesian
Polish
Vietnamese

This dataset was uploaded by Peter Devine (ptrdvn)
domain: general knowledge / model capability evaluation (instruction-following, reasoning, safety)
evaluation_method: human_eval (pairwise preference judgments and qualitative scoring)
reputation: MT-Bench is a widely used human-eval style benchmark for instruction-following LLMs; this Vietnamese translation is a community-contributed extension with limited adoption so far.
